title: 第六章 美女老师
slug: 重生末日最强生存系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

慢慢接近教学楼，周围安静的可怕，一个银针掉在地上估计都可以听见...

林夕让众人等在教学楼一楼的保安室内，锁好门。

自己一个人慢慢的开始一层一层的排查。

第一层某几间教室里加一起有个十几个丧尸，都被林夕一剑解决了

由于是高三补课所以学校的人没有那么多

林夕逐渐向二楼摸去，印象中二楼的高三班级有4个左右

林夕屏住呼吸一步一步的向上走去。

刚走到二楼楼道口便听到了细细碎碎的声音

林夕急忙停住脚步，探头望去，只见楼道口转角有几只丧尸在游荡。

听到四个教室其中的一间教室内有轻微的声音。

林夕便断定那个教室中一定有人。

当当当用剑轻敲地面，丧尸听到了声音均是向这边走来，林夕一个闪身冲到了走到第一个的丧尸面前，丧尸看到林夕顿时兴奋了起来唔唔唔的向林夕走来，林夕看着丧尸的步伐。

疑惑的心理想到：“是错觉吗，怎么感觉要比前面的丧尸行动要快一些。”边想边也没有墨迹

手起剑落，尸首分离。又斩掉几个丧尸的头颅之后。

林夕走到了教室门口，轻轻的敲了敲门，里面顿时传来轻微的声音，林夕小声开口说道：“有人吗？”这是一个魁梧的男生身上绑了好多书作为简易的盔甲手里拿着一根棒球棍

看到林夕以后二话不说便将林夕拽了进来。

“同学，你怎么样，没被咬吧。”这个魁梧的男生开口问道

Page (1/3)

Slowly approaching the teaching building, the surroundings were so quiet that you could probably hear a silver needle drop...

Lin Xi asked everyone to wait in the security room on the first floor of the teaching building and lock the door.

I slowly started to investigate layer by layer by myself.

There were more than a dozen zombies in some classrooms on the first floor, and they were all eliminated by Lin Xi with one sword.

Since it is a supplementary class for the senior year, there are not that many people in the school.

Lin Xi gradually moved toward the second floor. She had the impression that there were about 4 senior high school classes on the second floor.

Lin Xi held her breath and walked up step by step.

As soon as I walked to the entrance of the second floor corridor, I heard a faint sound.

Lin Xi hurriedly stopped and looked around, only to see a few zombies wandering around the corner of the corridor.

A slight sound was heard in one of the four classrooms.

Lin Xi concluded that there must be someone in that classroom.

Dangdang tapped the ground with his sword. When the zombies heard the sound, they all came this way. Lin Xi dodged and rushed in front of the first zombie. When the zombies saw Lin Xi, they suddenly became excited and walked towards Lin Xi. Lin Xi looked at the pace of the zombies.

I thought with doubts: "Is it an illusion? Why do I feel like the zombies move faster than the zombies in front of me?" There was no ink mark while thinking.

The sword fell from his hand, and the corpses were separated.After cutting off the heads of several more zombies.

Lin Xi walked to the door of the classroom and knocked gently. A slight sound suddenly came from inside. Lin Xi whispered, "Is there anyone there?" This was a burly boy with many books tied to his body as simple armor and a baseball bat in his hand.

After seeing Lin Xi, he dragged Lin Xi in without saying a word.

"Classmate, how are you? You haven't been bitten." The burly boy asked.
